purpose: Second-pass capture of rare mechanisms outside the obvious procedural-world lineage.

entries.mechanism: Rules of the local world are represented as physical manipulable objects; rearranging a sentence rewrites the active rule table immediately.
entries.genesis_use: Create explicitly bounded Rule Chambers where Players can discover and manipulate local laws without receiving authority over Genesis infrastructure. Useful for magic, laboratories, puzzles and Player-created micro-realities.

entries.mechanism: One accessible creation environment spans games, music, painting, animation, sculpture and movies, then makes those creations shareable inside the same community universe.
entries.genesis_use: Genesis creation language should converge rather than fragment into separate editors: the same primitives should be reusable across geometry, behavior, animation, sound and narrative.

entries.mechanism: Ordinary world materials compose into switches, circuits and Boolean logic gates, so inhabitants can build functioning machines inside the same world they inhabit.
entries.genesis_use: Give some Genesis materials lawful signal semantics so Players can construct behavior rather than only scenery. Machines should arise from world rules instead of a detached scripting UI when possible.

entries.mechanism: An ambitious simulated resource/ecology system met real Player pressure and exposed how a plausible closed simulation can fail once humans aggressively exploit it; the original lead designer later corrected simplified folklore about the exact failure modes.
entries.genesis_use: Never validate ecology only in zero-player simulation. Every living subsystem needs adversarial Player-pressure tests, carrying-capacity bounds, regeneration accounting and graceful degradation.

entries.mechanism: Known astronomical objects from catalogs coexist seamlessly with procedurally generated objects filling uncharted regions, using scientific knowledge as the grammar for generation.
entries.genesis_use: Do not force a choice between authored/observed truth and generative infinity. Preserve verified anchors exactly and procedurally fill only unresolved space, with provenance marking which is observed, authored, inferred or generated.

entries.mechanism: World containers can contain other world containers, including recursively/self-referentially, while remaining interactable as objects in their parent world.
entries.genesis_use: Treat rooms/worldlets/mirrors as nestable addressable domains. A Player Mirror may itself contain lawful subworlds, simulations or memories without confusing them with the parent canonical domain.

seal: THE RAREST IDEAS ARE NOT SKINS TO COPY; THEY ARE NEW KINDS OF LEVER. GENESIS COLLECTS THE LEVERS.
